purpose: Keep board curriculum, school category, medium, and school-prescribed textbook as separate dimensions. These profiles define the data model and do not assert that syllabus coverage is complete.

trackDefinitions.textbookRule: Use the current official Odisha textbook for the exact class, subject, medium, and academic session. Do not substitute NCERT chapters by default.

currentEvidence.note: BSE Odisha lists separate HSC and Madhyama syllabi for Classes IX and X for 2026-27. HSC and Madhyama must remain separate records.

trackDefinitions.coverageNote: Classes VI-VIII use SCERT textbook records; Classes IX-X must be mapped separately by HSC and Madhyama qualification. Class X HSC has only a partial English (SLE) extraction; no secondary track is marked verified.

trackDefinitions.textbookRule: Keep Madhyama Class IX/X syllabus and prescribed materials separate from HSC. Verify the exact academic session, subject, medium and official source before mapping questions.

currentEvidence.note: BSE Odisha lists separate Madhyama and HSC break-up syllabi for Classes IX and X; detailed chapter mappings are not yet verified.

trackDefinitions.coverageNote: Track separated in metadata only. Class IX and X subject-wise syllabus extraction, book mapping and QA remain pending.

trackDefinitions.textbookRule: Treat OAV as a distinct school profile. Verify its current class-wise curriculum and actual prescribed book/edition before mapping content; do not assume the State Board profile or a private school's list applies.
trackDefinitions.coverageNote: Separate OAV-specific current-session syllabus and prescribed-book mapping still needs official verification.

trackDefinitions.textbookRule: Store CBSE curriculum outcomes separately from each school's prescribed textbook title, publisher, edition, and school year. Never assume every CBSE school uses only NCERT textbooks.
trackDefinitions.coverageNote: School-specific profiles (for example DAV or St. Xavier's) must be created only from verified school-provided or official school sources.

trackDefinitions.textbookRule: Keep CISCE curriculum requirements distinct from school-selected textbooks, particularly in Classes VI-VIII. Verify class, subject, syllabus session, book title, and edition independently.
trackDefinitions.coverageNote: Full current-session syllabus and book mapping are pending.

statusDefinitions.not_verified: Profile or claim recorded, but current official evidence has not been checked.
statusDefinitions.in_review: Official sources are being checked; do not present the record as complete.
statusDefinitions.verified: Current session, class, subject, medium, source, chapter mapping and prescribed book status have been checked.
statusDefinitions.published: Verified record has original learning content and questions and passed content QA.
